name: My Pet Hisui
source:
Shiki couldn't protect the girl he had promised to protect after devil's spear attack. As he sees girl covered in blood he vows to have his revenge.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在恶魔之枪的袭击后，志贵无法保护他答应保护的女孩。当他看到女孩浑身是血时，他发誓要报仇。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
